shots.prompt: wide shot, huge futuristic academy arena, hundreds of students in stands, glowing crystal pillar in center, blue sky, epic scale

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In this world, every child awakens a talent at eighteen. Your rank decides everything. Your school. Your job. Your life.

shots.prompt: medium shot, standing in front of a glowing crystal pillar, hand on crystal, nervous expression, light reflecting on face

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kai Ren. First in every exam. The pride of Class Three.

shots.prompt: close up, crystal pillar flickering with dim grey light, giant letter F glowing faintly above it, gloomy

lines.speaker: examiner
lines.text: Kai Ren. Talent: Echo. Rank... F.

shots.prompt: students in arena stands laughing and pointing, mocking expressions, crowd shot
medium close up, laughing arrogantly, pointing finger, looking down at viewer, arena background

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: An F rank? Top of the class, and you get the weakest talent in history? Ha! Go back to your books, nerd.

shots.prompt: close up, head lowered, shadow over eyes, clenched fist, sad, rain-like light rays

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: ...Echo. A talent that only copies a skill for one second. One second.

shots.prompt: medium shot, stepping forward protectively, angry glare, arms crossed, arena background

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Drake, that's enough. Kai, ignore them. A rank isn't everything.

shots.prompt: night, small bedroom, sitting on bed alone, moonlight through window, holding a glowing blue screen in the air in front of him, surprised face

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: Host confirmed. Hidden trait unlocked. Every skill you echo... is yours forever.

shots.prompt: extreme close up on eyes, grey eyes glowing bright blue, determined, sparks of energy

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Forever? Then one second... is all I need.

shots.prompt: next day, training ground, punching with fist covered in roaring red flames, fire explosion, dynamic action pose

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: B rank! Flame Fist! Watch closely, trash, this is real power!

shots.prompt: action shot, catching a punch with one hand, his own hand now covered in blue flames, calm face, shockwave, debris flying
close up, shocked face, sweating, eyes wide, trembling, background speed lines

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Wh... what? That's my skill! How do you have my skill?!

shots.prompt: low angle hero shot, standing tall, blue flames swirling around body, coat flowing in wind, sunset sky, epic

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That day, they laughed at an F rank. They had no idea they were watching the birth of a monster.
